text:
maria: Heads up — after the 08:30 rollout I see a 30-40% token/sec drop for several production models. CTB queueing spikes and batches shrink to 1-2 sequences. Investigating now, adding probes. @sam @lee
sam: I see the same on the global dashboard. token/sec down ~12k -> ~7.5k, P95 latency up ~160ms. Any recent kernel-selection changes?
maria: deploy-bot shows PR merged right before the drop (08:28).
deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-05-14T08:28:42Z: merged PR #4021 by @arya -> canary rollout started.
lee: Quick flamegraph from service-9: kernel autopick now prefers `fast-memcopy` variant for short seqs. That path appears to disable the prefetch we rely on for CTB; KV cache miss rate jumped.
sam: Relevant tail from logs:
```
ctb: queued_ms=120 -> drain_ms=10 -> batch_size=1-2
kernel: selected=fast-memcopy
kv_cache: hit_rate=0.81 -> 0.61
kv_cache: miss_rate=0.19 -> prev=0.03
```
arya: The PR adjusted kernel scoring to bias memcpy when seq_len<64 and batch<4 (aim was latency for tiny requests). Didn't anticipate interaction with CTB prefetch heuristics.
maria: TL;DR: memcpy-preferred kernel + CTB workload -> prefetch suppressed -> memory thrash -> CTB starvation -> token/sec drop. This is blocking the rollout.
lee: Can we reproduce reliably on canary hosts? @deploy-bot which hosts are in canary group?
deploy-bot: Canary group: service-7, service-9, service-13.
sam: I'm SSHing into service-9 and attaching perf and kv traces now.
sam: Local quick test: force kernel selection back to previous policy -> token/sec returns to baseline. So revert should fix.
maria: Can we rollback PR 4021 on canary and freeze rollout?
arya: ACK, creating revert PR now.
deploy-bot: Revert PR created (#4023) — needs approvals.
lee: Postmortem items: add a CTB-aware kernel selection test, add a KV-hit pattern simulator in CI, and a benchmark that measures token/sec under KV miss-heavy tails.
sam: Also add an alert rule for sudden batch size collapse (median batch_size drop > 50% within 5m) and KV miss rate spikes.
maria: Revert merged on canary & rollback initiated. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for canary group.
maria: Observing recovery on service-9: token/sec 11.8k -> 12.1k within 45s. P95 latency trending down.
sam: Holding full rollout until CI test + alert added to PR checklist.
maria: Filed follow-up ticket PERF-572: "kernel selection regression tests + CTB/KV benchmark" and linked PR notes.
lee: Leaving detailed notes in the original PR and the revert. We'll want a follow-up that tunes scoring with CTB signals instead of pure seq_len/batch heuristics. :thumbsup:
arya: Thanks everyone. I'll own the follow-up and add the CI workloads to the PR template.
maria: Great. Blocking rollout removed for now. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
